nodes.label: main.go
nodes.description: Entry point: instantiates the game, handles I/O to/from stdin/stdout. Sets up command-line arguments and exits on quit or error. Imports: 0, game.

nodes.label: types.go
nodes.description: Types and interfaces for the chess game domain: 0, Pieces, BoardPosition. Used across various files. Imports: none.

nodes.label: game.go
nodes.description: Business logic for the game: 0, play, moves. Exports: Play(), ValidateMove(). Returns Errors on invalid input or moves. Imports: types.

nodes.label: board.go
nodes.description: Data access and manipulation layer for the game state: 0, moves. Exports: UpdateBoard(), GetPieceAt(). Thread-safe with mutex. Imports: types.

nodes.label: ui.go
nodes.description: UI functions for input/output: prompts user moves, renders game state in stdout. Imports: 0, game.

nodes.label: gamestate.go
nodes.description: GameState to represent all pieces and their positions. Exports: NewGameState(), Move Piece(). Implements: types.GameState interface.

nodes.label: moves.go
nodes.description: List of allowed moves for each piece type. Used by game to validate Moves. Exports: MovesForPiece(). Imports: types.

nodes.label: validations.go
nodes.description: Game validation logic implemented here. Checks for valid moves. Exports: ValidateMove(). Imports: 0, types.

nodes.label: errors.go
nodes.description: Error definitions for chess domain. Exports: InvalidMove error type. Imports: none.

nodes.label: tests/game_test.go
nodes.description: Unit tests for game-related logic. Imports: 0, game.

nodes.label: buildconfig.env
nodes.description: Environment variables for build settings. Imports: none.

nodes.label: ui.go
nodes.description: User interface layer. Renders output and handles user input. For CLI: prints formatted output, reads stdin. For web: HTML templates or JSON API responses. Imports: types, handlers.

nodes.label: handlers.go
nodes.description: API request handlers. Routes incoming requests to business logic, validates input, formats JSON responses. Handles HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). Imports: service, types.
